next.reason: 1985: "do not have values within the permissible range, the returned value for the function is undefined."; 2023: "the EC-ARGUMENT-FUNCTION exception condition is set to exist... the implementor defines the result of the function reference". Integer arguments and ALL subscripting carry over. Out-of-range arguments, undefined in 1985, now set EC-ARGUMENT-FUNCTION, and the result is implementor-defined if checking is not enabled.
